cost_note.zh: 一次性启动费：开线时快照年总收入÷52并限制在100至1,000,000,000，按双倍系数扣付。已付不退；后续确认条款不再收费。
cost_note.en: One-time setup fee: snapshot opening yearly gross income / 52, clamped to 100–1,000,000,000, then charge the double factor. Nonrefundable; later terms confirmation costs nothing.

consequence_note.zh: 入场须采用重商主义法、市场接入≥0.75、茶叶出口>50，且大顺与俄罗斯存在并均至少中立。付款当时给予地主支持+1，730日从首次付费选路起算；后续确认不续期。六个月观察只在条款确认且符合条件后累计。
consequence_note.en: Entry requires mercantilism, market access ≥0.75, tea exports >50, and existing Shun and Russia with relations at least neutral. Landowner approval +1 is applied on payment and runs 730 days from this first paid selection; later confirmation does not renew it. The six-month watch accrues only after terms are confirmed and qualified.
